# Recovered cinematic method

Source: Ash_Aether_Cinematic_Upgrade.zip, recovered from the user’s other session. Original artwork, edit timeline, README and concept cut are retained here. The original builder is preserved at development/recovered_cinematic_method.py as design provenance; its original relative directory layout is described in the recovered README. The reproducible in-game renderer is development/build_journey_cinema.py, using development/cinematic-input.json, these source boards and engine2/art/bestiary.webp. Run it from the Site checkout with Python, Pillow, NumPy, SciPy and FFmpeg.

The original cut contains new editorial captions and older proposed character designs; it is an optional concept film. In-game arrivals use environmental crops and current chapter titles. Creature cards use the current canonical twelve-design atlas. No new Runway or other generative-video calls were made.
